description.zh:
实例资源类型，取值说明：

- **StorageElastic**：存储弹性模式。
- **Serverless**：Serverless模式。
description.en:
The resource type of the instance. Valid values:

*   **StorageElastic**: elastic storage mode.
*   **Serverless**: Serverless mode.

description.zh: 不带前缀的内核版本号。
description.en: The minor version number that does not include the prefix.

description.zh:
地域ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~86912~~)接口查看可用的地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 实例当前所属的资源组ID。如何获取资源组ID，请参见[查看资源组基本信息](~~151181~~)。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs. For information about how to obtain the ID of a resource group, see [View basic information of a resource group](~~151181~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb describe-db-version-infos --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-mode StorageElastic --db-version '6.3.10.20。' --region cn-hangzhou
